baseline.description: Exact accepted release binaries preserved after the inference byte-offset boundary and before removal of the remaining ruby-analysis protocol dependency.

semantic_evidence.red_reproduction: A crate-wide architecture test failed because ruby-analysis directly depended on tower-lsp and fifteen reusable source modules exposed protocol positions, ranges, locations, symbols, tokens, or URLs.
semantic_evidence.accepted_boundary: ruby-analysis exposes domain SourcePosition, SourceRange, SourceFileId, TextRange, document-symbol kinds, semantic-token kinds, and byte-offset analyzer APIs. Root src adapters own every LSP conversion. The architecture test recursively scans every crate source file and its manifest.
semantic_evidence.dependency_tree: cargo tree -p ruby-analysis contains no tower-lsp or lsp-types package.
semantic_evidence.utf16_regression: A same-line identifier after a non-BMP prefix resolves through the analyzer position adapter, and completion after a non-BMP prefix retains the exact local receiver type.
semantic_evidence.scorecard: 85/85 reviewed cases, 100/100 points, revision m0-seed-22, score_eligible=false, claim_eligible=false
semantic_evidence.workspace_tests: cargo fmt --all -- --check, git diff --check, cargo check --workspace, and cargo test --workspace --quiet -- --test-threads=4 exited 0; every extension, integration, black-box, and doc-test target passed
semantic_evidence.cli_result: All five fresh final-release processes produced byte-identical valid JSON and the expected diagnostic exit status.

performance.measurement_note: The phase-summary process-wall median is 18.5045 ms higher, but user CPU is +0.30%, peak RSS improves, and the independently timed complete cold-indexing operation remains inside the fixed 3% focused gate at +2.9866%. Every interactive query and edit p95 improves, the 225,569-byte semantic pass is flat, retained engine heap is byte-identical, and every fixed production budget passes.
performance.decision: Accepted. The reusable-crate boundary adds no material semantic-pass, CPU, RSS, retained-heap, edit, or query regression and preserves deterministic output.

known_follow_ups: The scorecard remains deliberately claim-ineligible despite its seed-corpus score.
The goal-wide representative real-project precision review and packaging, warm-cache, allocation, worker-scheduling, and two-project RSS matrix remain open.
Duplicated inference paths and unsupported Ruby forms must continue to fail closed with explained Unknown until a complete shared proof rule is implemented.
